paper_title: Bromination of the benzothioxanthene Bloc: toward new π-conjugated systems for organic electronic applications

knowledge_points.content: Benzothioxanthene-3,4-dicarboximide (BTxI) can be selectively monobrominated at the 7-position (β position relative to the sulfur atom) using dilute bromine gas (Br2), whereas N-bromosuccinimide (NBS) is ineffective regardless of solvent or reaction time.
knowledge_points.evidence: Regardless of the concentration, nature of the solvent, and reaction time, no trace of a brominated compound was detected and only the starting imide-based derivative BTxI was systematically recovered... when exposed to a dilute solution of bromine (gas), the formation of a single product could be efficiently monitored... monobrominated... at the β position with regards to the sulphur atom (position 7).

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations at the OT-ωB97X-D/6-31G(d,p) level indicate that the 7-position is the most thermodynamically stable site for monobromination of BTxI, with a reaction free energy (ΔG) of -44.20 kcal/mol.
knowledge_points.evidence: DFT calculations suggest that the lowest energy Br-BTxI has the bromine atom located on the rylene core at the β position with regards to the sulphur atom (position 7). The free energy (ΔG) for the reaction is -44.20 kcal mol-1.

knowledge_points.content: The lack of dibrominated BTxI formation, even with excess bromine, is attributed to a kinetic barrier rather than thermodynamics, as the formation of 5,7-dibrominated BTxI is thermodynamically favorable with a free energy of -32.17 kcal/mol.
knowledge_points.evidence: The free energy for reaction to form (stepwise) 5,7-dibrominated BTxI is -32.17 kcal mol-1... Given the favorable thermodynamic driving force for the addition of a second bromine, it is hypothesized that it is a kinetic barrier that is responsible for the lack of formation of the dibrominated system.

knowledge_points.content: The monobrominated BTxI building block (Br-BTxI) is compatible with major cross-coupling reactions including Stille, Suzuki-Miyaura, Sonogashira, and direct (hetero)arylation, allowing for the synthesis of diverse pi-conjugated molecular structures.
knowledge_points.evidence: The major cross-coupling reactions, namely the Stille, Suzuki-Miyaura, Sonogashira and direct (hetero)arylation were successfully applied demonstrating the versatility of the Br-BTxI to afford simple and original molecular structures in high yields.

knowledge_points.content: The BTxI-based molecular donor (compound 4) exhibits a maximum absorption wavelength (λmax) of 409 nm in chloroform and an optical energy gap (Eg opt) of 2.17 eV in thin-film form.
knowledge_points.evidence: The latter indeed exhibits in solution a maximum absorption wavelength centered at 409 nm... absorption onset measured at ca. 570 nm, corresponding to an optical energy gap (Eg opt) of 2.17 eV.

knowledge_points.content: Compound 4, featuring an indacenodithiophene (IDT) core end-capped with BTxI, possesses a HOMO level of -5.19 eV and a LUMO level of -3.15 eV, making it suitable as a donor material when paired with PC61BM.
knowledge_points.evidence: Based on the onsets of the first oxidation and reduction potentials, 4 would appear to be compatible as an electron donor with the archetypal electron acceptor [6,6]-phenyl-C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PC61BM). ... HOMO (ev) 5.19, LUMO (ev) 3.15.

knowledge_points.content: Organic solar cells using compound 4 as the donor and PC61BM as the acceptor in a conventional architecture (ITO/PEDOT:PSS/4:PC61BM/LiF/Al) achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 2.08%.
knowledge_points.evidence: bulk heterojunction solar cells with the architecture: ITO/PEDOT-PSS/4:PC61BM/LiF/Al were fabricated... promising average power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 1.91% was reached with a maximum PCE of 2.08%.

knowledge_points.content: The organic solar cells based on the 4:PC61BM blend consistently yielded high open-circuit voltages (Voc) exceeding 1.0 V, with a maximum recorded Voc of 1.03 V.
knowledge_points.evidence: In these conditions, the average short-circuit current density (Jsc) open-circuit voltage (Voc) and fill-factor (FF) were 6.74 mA cm-2 1.03 V and 28% respectively. ... it is noteworthy that a Voc > 1 V was consistently reached.

knowledge_points.content: Optimal organic solar cell performance for the 4:PC61BM system was achieved using a 1:3 weight ratio in chloroform, with active layers spun-cast at 1000 rpm from a 10 mg/mL solution.
knowledge_points.evidence: Maximum power conversion efficiencies were reached with films spun-cast at 1000 rpm from chloroform solution containing 10 mg mL-1 of 4 and PC61BM in a 1:3 weight to weight ratio.

knowledge_points.content: The monobrominated structure of Br-BTxI was unequivocally confirmed through X-ray diffraction on single crystals, which validated the regioselectivity predicted by DFT calculations.
knowledge_points.evidence: single crystals... analyzed by X-ray diffraction. The molecular X-ray structure confirmed the DFT results that bromination occurs at the β position (Fig. 4).
